prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts of the crash, how much insurance is available, whether you need a trial lawyer, and how you prefer to work with an attorney. Instead of one name, here’s a practical way to find the best attorney for your situation plus a few well‑known Chicago plaintiff firms you can start with.

How to choose the right Chicago car-accident lawyer
- Look for plaintiff-side personal injury experience with car crashes (not insurance defense).
- Trial experience and a record of verdicts and settlements in serious car-accident cases.
- Experience handling cases like yours (catastrophic injury, whiplash, wrongful death, hit-and-run, uninsured motorist, motorcycle, rideshare, etc.).
- Contingency-fee arrangement (common — no fees unless they recover).
- Strong client reviews and peer recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, AVVO).
- Good communication: prompt answers, clear explanation of process and timeline.
- Local courtroom and insurance-company familiarity (Chicago and Cook County).
- Willingness to take the case to trial if settlement offers are too low.

Places to search and verify credentials
- Super Lawyers and Best Lawyers directories
- Martindale-Hubbell peer-review ratings
- Illinois State Bar Association / Chicago Bar Association lawyer referral
- Google and AVVO client reviews
- Ask friends/family or other attorneys for referrals

Reputable Chicago plaintiff firms to consider (good starting list)
- Clifford Law Offices — long-standing, high-profile plaintiff practice in serious auto cases
- Levin & Perconti — prominent in catastrophic injury and wrongful death cases
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — plaintiff firm experienced in motor vehicle collisions and wrongful death
- Kralovec, Jambois & Schwartz — plaintiff-focused personal injury attorneys in Chicago

(These are examples of firms frequently recommended for serious car-accident claims; you should still vet any individual attorney.)

Questions you should ask at a free consult
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled? Outcomes?
- Have you taken cases like this to trial? What were the results?
- Who will handle my case (attorney or paralegal)? How will you communicate with me?
- What are your fees and costs? Any upfront expenses for me?
- What’s a realistic range for my case and timeline to resolution?

If you want, tell me:
- Where in Chicago the crash occurred
- The date of the accident and types of injuries
- Any police report or insurance information
I can then shortlist a few attorneys/firms (with links and contact info) who match your needs and have relevant experience.
